title: Solid Upper Pro
description: Upper body strength: wide and decline push for pressing, inverse table rows and pulls for back

exercises.name: Joint rotations
exercises.instructions: Neck, shoulders, wrists, hips, ankles - slow and controlled

exercises.name: Side shuffles
exercises.instructions: Quick lateral shuffles, 3-4 steps each side

exercises.name: Inchworms
exercises.instructions: Standing, walk hands forward into a plank, then walk back

exercises.name: Cat-cow
exercises.instructions: On all fours, alternate cat and cow, breathe

exercises.name: Wide push-ups
exercises.instructions: Hands wider than shoulders, focus on chest

exercises.name: Decline push-ups
exercises.instructions: Feet elevated on a chair, body braced

exercises.name: Hindu push-ups
exercises.instructions: Dive-bomb movement: dip down then sweep up in an arc

exercises.name: Inverse table rows
exercises.instructions: Under a table, pull chest toward the edge

exercises.name: Prone Y raises
exercises.instructions: Lying face down, arms in Y position, lift and hold 2s

exercises.name: Reverse snow angels
exercises.instructions: Lying face down, arms along body, arc along the floor

exercises.name: Chest stretch
exercises.instructions: Arm against a wall at 90 degrees, rotate the body

exercises.name: Scorpion stretch
exercises.instructions: Lying face down, bring foot toward opposite hand while rotating

exercises.name: Child's pose
exercises.instructions: Kneeling, arms extended forward, forehead on the floor, breathe deeply

exercises.name: Deep breathing
exercises.instructions: Inhale 4s through the nose, hold 4s, exhale 6s through the mouth
